{{color2|fff|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |} ==Quotes== {{Main|Phoebe/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===GOTCHA!=== Phoebe briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Hoenn Elite Four Adventures.png|200px|thumb|Phoebe in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:ORAS Gym Leaders Elite Four Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|Phoebe in the thirteenth chapter]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== Phoebe and the other Elite Four members were called by {{Steven}} to help protect the Hoenn [[region]] from the {{pkmn|battle}} between {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Groudon}} and {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Kyogre}}. While the other Elite Four are tasked with attempting to open the chambers containing the Legendary Pokémon {{p|Regirock}}, {{p|Regice}}, and {{p|Registeel}}, Phoebe goes to meet with a [[blind boy]] that holds a slab that has the secret to awaken the three Pokémon. After the slab is translated and Steven manages to awaken the Legendary Pokémon, Phoebe is tasked with controlling Regice alongside Glacia. The Elite Four, Steven, and Wallace all control the three [[legendary giants]] in three pairs of two and use their power to keep the power released from Groudon and Kyogre's battle from spreading throughout Hoenn. They manage to keep the power contained for several weeks, but the strain is too much for Steven and he eventually dies, causing the three Pokémon to lash out and flee. Phoebe later mourns Steven's death before his revival at the hands of {{adv|Ruby}}'s {{p|Celebi}}. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== Phoebe, along with various people from around Hoenn, is called to [[Sootopolis City]] to assist in stopping [[Grand Meteor Delta]], a giant meteoroid threatening to destroy the planet. When the plan to attack Grand Meteor Delta starts, Phoebe and the others have their Pokémon attack the meteoroid at the same time. This, combined with the might of [[Mega Evolution|Mega]] {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}}, successfully shatters Grand Meteor Delta into pieces. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Phoebe's Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Phoebe |pkmn=Dusclops |type1=Ghost |img=Phoebe Dusclops Adventures.png |img_size=120px |epnum=PS251 |epname=The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XIII |desc={{p|Dusclops}} is Phoebe's only known Pokémon. It was first seen with its Trainer when they appeared before Wallace with Steven and the other Elite Four members. Later, it was used to save the {{tc|Swimmer}} and blind boy from the crumbling buildings of [[Slateport City]]. Dusclops's only known move is {{m|Shadow Punch}}.}} =====Temporary===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Phoebe |pkmn=Regice |type1=Ice |img=Brandon Regice Adventures.png |epnum=PS254 |epname=A Royal Rumble with Regirock, Regice and Registeel II |main=Brandon's legendary giants |main_section=Pokémon Adventures |desc={{p|Regice}} was awakened by Steven and the Elite Four to be used to contain Groudon and Kyogre's power. Phoebe controlled Regice with Glacia while the others controlled Regirock and Registeel. After Steven died from the strain of controlling the three Pokémon, Regice lashed out and ran away.
